STEP 2: Bring water to a rolling boil over high heat, then remove pot from heat and cover
STEP 3: Let eggs sit for 10-12 minutes, then transfer to ice water to cool before peeling
CONCLUSION: Properly boiled eggs are cooked through, easy to peel, and safe to eat when following correct timing and cooling methods
